specName: Feed always matches the selected tag
expectations: No new UI or reader-visible state
No change to API responses or URL format
context: constraint: no barrels, ~ aliases, TanStack Query for server state

FR-001.title: List shows only articles for the selected tag, source and page

FR-002.title: A response for a no-longer-selected tag, source or page never changes the list

FR-003.title: Cancel the previous selection request where the client allows

FR-004.title: A cancelled or superseded request shows no error

FR-005.title: A failed request for the current selection still shows its error

FR-006.title: Cancellation works for every article-fetching call

FR-007.title: No new screen, control, message or state for the reader

intent: The article list always matches the selected tag; stale responses are ignored and their requests cancelled

verified.result: [plan-check] plan.md: 1 call path, 3 lines, 1 code block. Every cited file and line checks out.

decisions.why: It renders the previous key's articles under the new selection, breaking FR-001/FR-002; without it Suspense shows the existing skeleton
decisions.rejected: Keep it for page changes only, or add a request counter in the widget

decisions.decision: No new cancellation plumbing; test it instead
decisions.why: Every read already forwards TanStack signal to axios

decisions.decision: No CanceledError handling unless a test shows a cancel reaching ErrorHandler
decisions.why: TanStack reverts aborted queries without an error state

plan.summary: One-line fix in article.api.ts plus widget tests for race, cancel, error
plan.key_finding: Cancellation already works; the stale list comes from keepPreviousData

approach: Drop keepPreviousData so the feed widget only renders data under the current selection key. Pin the behaviour with a widget test for out-of-order responses, cancellation and error display.
